body:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate detected on caching.GET for prefix 'tenant:acme'* — alert INC-2026-4913. 10m error spike, 5xx ratio 22%. Priority: P1.

oncall-amy: acked. pulling up traces now, paging @beth_sre and @chris_eng. heading to call room.

beth_sre: I see sudden KV fetch misses + a handful of 500s from the prefix lookup path. Stack traces point to kv-prefix-router  -> kv-store shard 7 timing out.

chris_eng: looking at recent deploys — no runtime releases in last 6h. There was a config push to prefix-routing rules at 2026-03-26T11:43Z (rolling). grabbing diff.

dave_prod: Support reported a customer-visible correctness issue: some outputs returned stale or malformed extra tokens. Possibly due to cache poisoning / stale prefix entries. @elle_support any customer examples?

elle_support: AcmePay (acct: acme) reported failing transactions and weird model responses around 11:52AM. Provided logs showing generation with repeated filler tokens and incorrect account ids.

frank_ce: Impact: 3 enterprise tenants with high QPS (AcmePay, Ledgerly, MarketOps). Might be correctness > availability. Need to treat as data correctness incident.

oncall-amy: Decision thread: 1) Disable prefix caching for tenant:acme (surgical) 2) Apply temporary rate cap on prefetched KV path for shard 7 to avoid cascading timeouts 3) Route affected requests to consistent read path (no KV short-circuit) 4) Notify support and customers. Who can run bypass?

chris_eng: I can push bypass for tenant:acme. Plan: curl ops-api to set prefix_cache.mode=bypass for that prefix, then monitor. Command:
```
# run from runbook bot account
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/v1/cache/override" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RUNBOOK_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prefix":"tenant:acme","mode":"bypass","reason":"INC-2026-4913 correctness"}'
```

beth_sre: Adding rate-limit rule on ingress for prefix path to 200rps to avoid shard meltdown. Running traffic-sculpt: `rb traffic set-rule --path /kv/prefix --prefix tenant:acme --limit 200`

ops-bot: runbook: Applied traffic rule rb-752: ingress limit 200rps for prefix tenant:acme.

oncall-amy: Applying both now. chris — please apply bypass and post the response. I'll watch traces and error budget.

chris_eng: applied override, got 200 OK: `{ "status":"applied","id":"override-1926-100" }`.

beth_sre: rate-limit change applied, verified via metrics: per-shard queue depth dropping, error ratio trending down to 4% over 3 minutes.

frank_ce: Customer comms drafted: "We identified an issue with prefix caching affecting a subset of requests for your account. We have temporarily disabled prefix caching for your traffic and are mitigating side effects. We will follow up with root cause and timeline." PTAL @elle_support.

elle_support: Sent to AcmePay and Ledgerly watchers. AcmePay acknowledged, they want ETA. Told them immediate mitigation in place, we'll update in 30m.

dave_prod: Any downstream fallout from bypass (cost/latency)? Expect higher P95. Tagging billing and SRE to watch.

oncall-amy: Observed latency P95 for tenant:acme went from 120ms -> 420ms after bypass. Acceptable for now to preserve correctness. We'll consider targeted traffic-shaping if cost or SLA violations surface.

chris_eng: Investigating root cause: KV prefix router had an inconsistent cache invalidation path for prefixes with suffix wildcard. There's a race when redis eviction + background sync occur. I can repro locally with a synthetic traffic pattern.

beth_sre: For fallout mitigation, suggestion: escalate to slow-path routing only when cache miss + tenant flagged. Implemented as a canary: route 10% of tenant traffic to consistent read path first, then 100% once stable. We'll keep bypass in place for now.

frank_ce: Noting: Dedicated customers on reserved capacity unaffected because they use pinned KV pools — only shared pools hit this.

op-bot: alert-mute INC-2026-4913 applied for channel for 30m to avoid noise.

oncall-amy: Handoff: I'm on initial containment. Next oncall @beth_sre will take over monitoring and RCA. @beth_sre please create postmortem stub and include timeline and customer impact.

beth_sre: Creating postmortem: will capture timeline, mitigations, runbooks, and follow-ups (ensure atomic invalidation for prefix wildcard keys, add unit/integration test for eviction race).

chris_eng: Immediate next steps: 1) Add guard to prefix invalidation: require version token. 2) Add rate-adaptive backoff in kv-router. 3) Run replay tests for eviction patterns.

elle_support: Customer update sent: "We have applied a temporary bypass; we expect restored correctness immediately. We will follow up with further technical details and timeline for permanent fix." AcmePay replied: "Thanks — please keep us updated."

frank_ce: Logging action items: add metric for 'prefix-cache-consistency-failures', create alert when >0.5% customer-visible incorrect responses. Also coordinate billing watch for unexpected token cost.

oncall-amy: Closing notes: Incident resolved to containment (correctness fixed by bypass). Root cause suspected cache invalidation race. Postmortem owners: @beth_sre (lead), @chris_eng (engineer). Will schedule deep dive with infra and runtime teams.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-4913 status: CONTAINED. Tracking: follow-ups and postmortem assigned.

ops-bot: Handoff recorded to beth_sre. Bookmark: runbook://incidents/INC-2026-4913
